content: .{@-प्रसवः@} .²1 (As opposed to अनुप्रसव) tracing causes back to the origin as --a pot, a lump of mud, mud, clay. <ls>Pātañjala Yogadarśana.</ls> .²2 Negation of (or exception to) a negation. The force of a प्रतिप्रसव is positive, limiting as it does the scope of a प्रतिषेध or negation. Hence it is just the opposite of परिसंख्या whose force is negative or exclusive since it limits the scope of a positive statement. प्रतिप्रसवोऽयं न परिसंख्या <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 7. 45</ls>.

प्रतिप्रसवः .²1 A counter-exception, an exception to an exception (wherein the general rule is shown to be applicable to cases falling under the exception); तृजकाभ्यां कर्तरि इत्यस्य प्रतिप्रसवोऽयं (याजकादिभिश्च) <ls>Sk.</ls> .²2 A contrary effect.
